mapper.select: SELECT id, name, sortOrder, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM workcategory ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, createdAt ASC
SELECT id, name, sortOrder, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM workcategory WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workcategory (id, name, sortOrder, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE workcategory SET name=#{name}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE workcategory SET sortOrder=#{sortOrder}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
